title: 3Sum Closest
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer target, find three integers in nums such that the sum is closest to target. Return the sum of the three integers.
pseudocode:
nums.sort()
closestSum = nums[0] + nums[1] + nums[2]
for i = 0 to nums.length - 2:
  left = i + 1, right = nums.length - 1
  while left < right:
    sum = nums[i] + nums[left] + nums[right]
    if abs(target - sum) < abs(target - closestSum):
      closestSum = sum
    if sum < target: left++
    else if sum > target: right--
    else: return target
return closestSum

steps.note: Sort the array in non-decreasing order: [-4, -1, 1, 2].
Initialize closestSum with the first triplet sum: -4 + (-1) + 1 = -4.
Set left pointer to index 1 (val -1) and right pointer to index 3 (val 2).
|1 - (-3)| = 4, which is closer than |1 - (-4)| = 5. Update closestSum to -3.
Current sum -3 is less than target 1. Increment left pointer to index 2.
|1 - (-1)| = 2, which is closer than |1 - (-3)| = 4. Update closestSum to -1.
Current sum -1 is less than target 1. Increment left pointer to index 3.
left pointer equals right pointer (3 == 3). Inner loop terminates for i = 0.
Set left pointer to index 2 (val 1) and right pointer to index 3 (val 2).
|1 - 2| = 1, which is closer than |1 - (-1)| = 2. Update closestSum to 2.
Current sum 2 is greater than target 1. Decrement right pointer to index 2.
left pointer equals right pointer (2 == 2). Inner loop terminates for i = 1.
